When Code Stopped Being the Main Thing

MAR — JUN 2026 · Retrospective

An AI experiment changed how I valued architecture—and what I wanted to build next.

I Didn't Want AI to Design My System for Me

MAY — OCT 2026 · Retrospective

I used definitions and versioned configurations to keep fast implementation aligned with the architecture.

We Built All the Pieces. Then We Had to Make Them Work Together.

AUG — OCT 2026 · Retrospective

We had the components. Integration work made one complete sale through the FakeBank simulator possible.
